(Japanese: '''ポケモン３Ｄアドベンチャー　ミュウを探せ！''' ''Pokémon 3D Adventure: Find Mew!'') is the 14th [[Pikachu short]] of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It first aired at 109 Cinemas Nagoya adjacent to the {{OBP|PokéPark|theme park}} theme park from March 18 to September 25, 2005 as part of the [[M08|2005 Pikachu Project]].<ref>https://web.archive.org/web/20050116020347/http://www.pokemon2005.jp/news/subwin/0114_3d.html</ref> It was screened again in 2017<ref>https://www.pokemon-movie.jp/news/?p=2498</ref> and 2020<ref>https://www.toyohaku.gr.jp/sizensi/03event/2019/theater/2020zenki.html</ref> together with [[PK16]] in Japanese theaters.

{{AP|Pikachu}} and {{MTR}} are on a search for the elusive Pokémon, {{p|Mew}}. They search everywhere! The sea, the sky, the woods...will they ever find Mew?
